title: Build Approval Center panel
purpose: Turn approval visibility into a focused operator workflow that makes risky decisions easier to inspect and deny.
scope: Render pending, expired, denied and stale approvals in a dedicated panel.
Show exact binding context, policy reason, expiry and target resource.
Show approve and deny commands with equal visual weight.
Separate actionable approvals from expired or stale approvals.
Keep approval authority in AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
acceptance_criteria: Approval Center cannot render an actionable approval without exact binding context.
Expired and stale approvals are visible but not actionable.
Deny path remains as discoverable as approve path.
No raw secret-like values appear in approval panels.
failure_modes: Stale token can be reused through focused panel state.
Approval panel hides policy reason or rollback consequence.
